Package dev.px.core.hud

Interface HudElement

All Superinterfaces:
Named
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractHudElement, ExampleBrokenElement, ExampleClock, ExampleDial, ExampleRadar, ExampleWatermark
public interface HudElement extends Named
Something drawn on the HUD.

Two methods are mandatory: how big you are, and how to draw yourself. That is the whole contract, and it is deliberately the whole contract — adding an element type must never require understanding the layout engine. Anchoring, scaling, clamping, z-order, hit testing, dragging and persistence are all handled above this interface.

Everything here works in natural, unscaled coordinates. The element's scale factor is applied by HudService as a transform, so an element that never mentions scale is automatically scalable.

Core knows nothing about what an element shows. There is no FPS counter, no armour bar and no module list in here; those are the adapter's, built on this. 


 public final class WatermarkElement extends AbstractHudElement {

     public WatermarkElement() {
         super("watermark", "Watermark");
     }

     @Override
     public Size getPreferredSize() {
         return Size.of(Render.textWidth(label()) + 8f, Render.textHeight() + 6f);
     }

     @Override
     public void render(float x, float y, float w, float h) {
         Render.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 3f, Core.themes().getSurface());
         Render.text(label(), x + 4f, y + 3f, Color.WHITE);
     }
 }

  • Method Details

    • getId

      String getId()
      Stable identity, used as the config key and the registry key.

      Must not change between builds: renaming it orphans every saved layout for this element. Keep it lowercase and separate from the display label, which is free to change.

    • getPreferredSize

      Size getPreferredSize()
      Current natural size.

      Expected to differ every frame. A clock is wider at 12:00 than 1:00, an ArrayList grows as modules are toggled. Nothing caches this, and the anchor formula makes a size change move the element in the right direction on its own.

    • render

      void render(float x, float y, float w, float h)
      Draws the element with its top-left corner at (x, y).

      w and h are the natural size reported by getPreferredSize() this frame, not the scaled size: any scale factor is already applied as a transform around this call.

    • getShape

      default Shape getShape(float x, float y, float w, float h)
      The clickable region, in natural coordinates within the given rectangle.

      Defaults to the whole rectangle, which is right for almost everything. Override it when the drawn shape is not a rectangle, so that clicking the corner of a circular element correctly misses it and the editor's selection outline traces the real shape.

    • defaultLayout

      default HudLayout defaultLayout()
      Where this element sits before a user moves it, and what resetLayout restores.

    • getDisplayName

      default String getDisplayName()
      Human-readable label for the editor. Free to change; getId() is not.

    • getName

      default String getName()
      The registry key is the id.

      Named is what lets a Registry hold elements and give duplicate detection and lookup for free; the id is the stable name, and getDisplayName() is the one shown to users.
